k-12.title: Who dey do am? Dropped subjects
k-12.goal: Work out who person mean for chat where subjects drop out, find line wey still unclear, and write short chat where one clue still show who.
k-12.material:
수미 and 태호 work for same office. Dem dey try reach dem 부장님 (department head). 비서 mean di head secretary.

수미: 부장님한테 전화했어요?
태호: 네, 했는데 안 받으세요.
수미: 비서한테는 물어봤어요?
태호: 네, 물어봤더니 지금 회의 중이시래요.
k-12.thinking.0: Understand dropped subjects from honorific endings
k-12.s.s1.prompt: For 태호 last line, who dey meeting?
k-12.s.s1.hint.1: Who for this chat deserve honorific?
k-12.s.s1.r.b: Speaker no go use honorific ending -시- for imself.
k-12.s.s1.r.c: 수미 no be di person dem dey talk about; honorific ending also point to somebody senior.
k-12.s.s1.r.d: Secretary na person wey answer, no be di person for meeting.
k-12.s.s1.explain: '회의 중이시래요' get honorific -시-, wey show say subject na person wey deserve respect: di 부장님.
k-12.s.s2.hint.0: Find who 태호 ask for di previous line.
k-12.s.s2.r.b: 태호 ask di secretary, no be di head, and na di head dey busy for meeting.
k-12.s.s2.r.c: 수미 na di person asking, no be di one wey answer.
k-12.s.s2.r.d: Di earlier line '비서한테는 물어봤어요?' make am clear.
k-12.s.s2.explain: '물어봤더니 ... -래요' = 'when I ask, (dem) talk say ...'. Person wey dem ask for previous line na 비서.
k-12.s.s3.prompt: For another chat, one line no make clear who dem mean, even though verb honorific, because two respected people dey conversation. Pick am.
k-12.s.s3.hint.0: Find people for chat wey dem go use -시- when talking about dem.
k-12.s.s3.hint.1: For each line, ask if dem mention subject or you only fit guess am.
k-12.s.s3.explain: '연락하신대요' get -시-, so na respected person, but both 사장님 and 팀장님 fit, and earlier lines mention both together. Reader no fit know who go call again; add subject ('사장님이 ...' or '팀장님이 ...') to make am clear.
k-12.s.s4.prompt: Create your own two-line Korean chat (polite speech) about school or work: one person ask wetin teacher or boss talk or do, and answer drop subject but honorific ending still show who.
k-12.s.s4.hint.0: Choose respected person like 선생님 or 부장님.
k-12.s.s4.hint.1: Ask with 뭐라고 하셨어요? or 오셨어요?
k-12.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Reader fit know who do am without subject?
k-12.s.s4.selfAssess.1: I use honorific only for person wey deserve am?
k-12.s.s4.modelNote.1: Honorific verb for answer; subject dropped.

k-01.title: A ‘no’ wey never say no
k-01.goal: Infer from short chat say softened reply refuse one day but no reject whole plan, point to evidence, then write your own soft refusal with another option.
k-01.material:
Two classmates, 민수 and 수진, text each other. Dem use polite -요 speech to each other. (😅 = face with small sweat drop, awkward smile.)

민수: 토요일에 영화 볼까요?
수진: 토요일은 좀… 😅
민수: 그럼 일요일은요?
수진: 일요일은 좋아요!
k-01.thinking.0: Infer refusal wey no talk direct
k-01.thinking.1: Separate wetin dem refuse (the day) from wetin dem no refuse (the plan)
k-01.prereq.1: E know basic -아요/어요 endings and days of week
k-01.s.s1.hint.0: Read 민수 next line: how e react?
k-01.s.s1.hint.1: Notice say 수진 no talk 네 or 아니요. Wetin she leave unfinished?
k-01.s.s1.o.a: Saturday no good for her; she dey decline that day.
k-01.s.s1.o.b: Saturday sweet her and she dey excited.
k-01.s.s1.r.b: '좀…' wey stop midway with awkward emoji na hesitation, no be excitement. See how di next line (그럼 일요일은요?) react.
k-01.s.s1.o.c: She no ever wan watch movie with 민수.
k-01.s.s1.r.c: This one read too much inside am. Her last line, 일요일은 좋아요!, show say she still wan go.
k-01.s.s1.r.d: She answer di question direct by naming di day, so she understand am.
k-01.s.s1.explain: '좀…' make refusal softer so nobody need talk '안 돼요'. Topic marker -은 for '토요일은' point to Saturday, and 민수 respond by offering another day.
k-01.s.s2.prompt: Which evidence show say 수진 still wan see di movie? Choose all.
k-01.s.s2.hint.0: Find di lines where she talk something positive.
k-01.s.s2.hint.1: Compare wetin she name for '토요일은 좀…' with wetin she name for '일요일은 좋아요!'.
k-01.s.s2.o.a: She answer '일요일은 좋아요!' when 민수 offer Sunday.
k-01.s.s2.r.b: '좀' make refusal softer; e no talk if she like di plan.
k-01.s.s2.r.c: Di emoji show say she feel awkward, no be say she wan see di movie.
k-01.s.s2.o.d: She talk '토요일은', naming only di day, no be di movie itself.
k-01.s.s2.explain: She no reject di movie. She only reject Saturday (토요일은), and she accept Sunday.
k-01.s.s2.acc.0: To mention only di clearest evidence (she accept Sunday) make sense; d add say she name only di day, no be di film.
k-01.s.s3.prompt: Your classmate 민수 invite you to chop outside on Saturday, but you no fit go. Reply for Korean with 요-speech: no talk '싫어요', soften di refusal, and offer another day.
k-01.s.s3.hint.0: Start by saying sorry or say na shame, then mention Saturday.
k-01.s.s3.hint.1: Say sorry or give short reason, then end with question to suggest another day.
k-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: My reply make am clear say I no fit do Saturday?
k-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: I keep di friendship warm (softener, alternative)?
k-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: 민수 go know wetin to do next?
k-01.s.s3.modelNote.0: Short and soft; e use 좀 and offer one day.
k-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: E give reason instead of 좀, then suggest Sunday.

k-02.title: Talking to shop worker
k-02.goal: Notice which customer lines too casual for stranger for shop, decide why, and rewrite dem politely.
k-02.material: For fruit shop. Di worker and customer no know each other. Both look like adults.
k-02.thinking.0: Judge speech level based on relationship
k-02.thinking.1: Find di lines wey cause di problem
k-02.s.s1.prompt: One or more customer lines sound too casual for talking to worker wey you no know. Pick one.
k-02.s.s1.hint.0: Compare customer endings with worker endings.
k-02.s.s1.hint.1: Check how each customer line end: e end with -요/-습니다?
k-02.s.s1.explain: '얼마야?' and '줘' na 반말 (casual speech). Strangers normally dey use polite speech with each other: '얼마예요?' and '주세요'.
k-02.s.s2.prompt: Di worker use polite speech (-요) with customer. Customer fit answer with casual speech (반말) because of that?
k-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ask yourself: dem know each other?
k-02.s.s2.hint.1: Imagine customer na stranger for bus. Which speech level you go use?
k-02.s.s2.o.a: No. Strangers use polite speech both ways; worker dey polite because na im job.
k-02.s.s2.o.b: Yes. Both na adults wey dey talk, so casual speech okay.
k-02.s.s2.r.b: Being adults no make casual speech okay; with stranger, safe choice na polite speech both ways.
k-02.s.s2.o.c: Yes. Customer dey pay, so na customer decide.
k-02.s.s2.r.c: Payment no change di relationship. Customers too normally use polite speech.
k-02.s.s2.o.d: No, but only because worker much older.
k-02.s.s2.r.d: Age fit matter, but nobody give age here. Main reason na say dem be strangers.
k-02.s.s2.explain: Default between strangers na polite speech both ways. For shops, worker polite speech na service language; e no give customer right to use 반말.
k-02.s.s3.prompt: Rewrite customer two casual lines ('이 귤 얼마야?' and '그럼 두 봉지 줘.') to fit this situation.
k-02.s.s3.hint.0: Change both line endings to polite form.
k-02.s.s3.hint.1: Think about wetin you talk when ordering for café.
k-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Worker wey I no know go feel respected?
k-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Request wey a little more formal.

k-03.title: Di times match?
k-03.goal: Compare short notice with friend text, notice say times no match, and ask good clarifying question instead of agreeing.
k-03.material:
Today na Friday, 10월 23일. Your school get notice and your friend text you.

[소풍 안내]
- 날짜: 10월 24일 토요일
- 장소: 한강공원
- 버스 출발: 아침 8시 30분 (학교 앞)
- 준비물: 도시락, 물, 편한 신발

친구 문자: "내일 7시에 학교 앞에서 만나요! 도시락 꼭 가져와요."
k-03.thinking.0: Combine information from notice and message
k-03.thinking.1: Decide wetin to ask before you answer
k-03.thinking.2: Remove question about something wey no matter
k-03.s.s1.prompt: Before you reply, which question go help you ask your friend pass?
k-03.s.s1.hint.0: Find every time for notice and text, then compare dem.
k-03.s.s1.hint.1: Which question ask about something you DON'T already know from notice?
k-03.s.s1.r.a: Notice already talk bus time, so this question no add anything.
k-03.s.s1.r.c: Text only say make you carry lunch box; where to buy am no be di problem.
k-03.s.s1.r.d: Notice already confirm di picnic day.
k-03.s.s1.r.e: Asking AM or PM fit be first step, but bus dey leave morning, so evening meeting no make sense. Real problem na gap between bus time and meeting time.
k-03.s.s1.explain: Di two sources differ (notice say bus leave at 8:30, text say meet at 7:00). Best question point to di difference so friend fit explain.
k-03.s.s1.acc.0: Asking AM/PM na reasonable first clarification, but e no show yet say you notice di 8:30 bus time.
k-03.s.s2.prompt: Write your question to your friend for Korean (friendly -요 speech). Mention both di bus time (or notice) and di 7:00 meeting.
k-03.s.s2.hint.0: Put di bus time and your friend time together in one sentence.
k-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: My question show say I notice di two times different?
k-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: My friend fit answer am with one short sentence?

k-04.title: Shopping with limits
k-04.goal: Turn short text message wey leave out some words to exact limits, find several shopping baskets wey meet dem, and report one for Korean.
k-04.material:
Your friend text before you go market:

"시장에 가요? 그럼 사과랑 귤 좀 사 와요. 만 원까지 쓸 수 있어요. 귤이 사과보다 많아야 해요. 모두 5봉지 이상이요."

[가격표]
사과 한 봉지: 2,000원
귤 한 봉지: 1,000원
k-04.prereq.2: E don meet -까지 (up to), -보다 (than) and 이상 (this number or more); dem explain am for hints
k-04.s.s1.prompt: Wetin '만 원까지 쓸 수 있어요' tell you?
k-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ask whether your friend go vex if you spend 8,000 won.
k-04.s.s1.o.a: You fit spend up to 10,000 won, but no more.
k-04.s.s1.r.b: '까지' set limit, no be exact amount.
k-04.s.s1.o.c: You must spend at least 10,000 won.
k-04.s.s1.r.c: That na opposite: minimum instead of maximum.
k-04.s.s1.r.d: Price list get di prices; 만 원 na di money wey you fit use.
k-04.s.s1.explain: '-까지' mark upper limit: up to 10,000 won, and spending less dey okay.
k-04.s.s2.prompt: Find 3 baskets wey meet every condition for message, each with different number of apple bags. a = bags of apples, g = bags of tangerines.
k-04.s.s2.hint.0: First write di conditions with your own words: '-보다 많아야 해요' = must pass; '이상' = this number or more.
k-04.s.s2.hint.1: Try a = 1 and increase g until total reach 5 bags.
k-04.s.s2.hint.2: Check money last: 2,000 × a + 1,000 × g, then change a.
k-04.s.s2.ok.c1: You buy both apples and tangerines.
k-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Di message ask for both 사과 and 귤 (at least one bag of each).
k-04.s.s2.ok.c2: More tangerine bags than apple bags.
k-04.s.s2.fail.c2: 귤이 사과보다 많아야 해요: tangerine bags must pass apple bags.
k-04.s.s2.fail.c3: 모두 5봉지 이상: at least 5 bags total.
k-04.s.s2.explain: For example, 1 apple + 4 tangerines = 6,000 won; 2 + 3 = 7,000 won; 3 + 4 = 10,000 won. Plenty baskets fit because message give limits, no be one exact order.
k-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Choose ONE basket and send your friend short Korean text (polite -요) saying how many bags of each fruit you buy and di total.
k-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Use one basket from above: which two numbers?
k-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Talk di apple number, tangerine number, then total in won.
k-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Di numbers for my text match one basket wey I make?

k-05.s.s1.hint.0: Decide using only wetin you don read so far.
k-05.s.s1.prompt: Read each part, choose most likely interpretation and continue.
k-05.title: Wetin di neighbor mean?
k-05.goal: Change your understanding of indirect complaint as more of di conversation show, then write suitable note to neighbor.
k-05.material: You live for apartment 302. Adult from apartment 202 (floor below), wey you no know well, stop you for elevator.
k-05.thinking.1: Change your meaning as more talk reveal
k-05.thinking.2: Understand owner wey dem no mention
k-05.s.s1.hint.1: Look at sentence endings (…, -서요, -는데) to see wetin dem leave unsaid.
k-05.s.s1.st.0.after: For this point, na small talk or hint about problem fit be, but '들려서요…' end with reason and leave result unsaid, wey often signal complaint.
k-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Nothing for sentence suggest moving out; neighbor wey wan that go talk much more direct.
k-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: No invitation words (like 놀러 오세요) dey. Sentence na about sounds wey dey disturb speaker.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Whose baby e be, and wetin neighbor dey hope for?
k-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Speaker no mention whose baby, but na neighbour baby wake because of sound from upstairs. Dem hope make noise reduce, no be make you move.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Na their baby; dem hope evening noise go reduce
k-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Na your baby; dem wan help you
k-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: The baby na the one wey wake because of sound from upstairs, so e belong to speaker, no be you.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Na their baby; dem want make you move
k-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Speaker hope na about noise, no be where you live; nothing show say dem want you move.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Nobody baby; na only small talk
k-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: The baby details (자는데, 깨서요) na reason for request, so e pass small talk.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.after: ‘아니에요, 감사해요’ and ‘좀 부탁드려요’ show calm, polite request wey only concern after 9 p.m.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: No vex; accept your plan and ask for quiet after 9
k-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: ‘아니에요, 감사해요’ get calm, thankful tone, no be angry.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Want make children stop running anytime
k-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Dem only ask for after 9 (‘9시 이후만’), no be make dem stop running all the time.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Dem still talk ‘부탁드려요’, so quiet after 9 matter to dem.
k-05.s.s1.reflect: Notice how complaint fit come from small hints: first unfinished sentence, then reason, then request. Politeness no mean say no request dey.
k-05.s.s2.prompt: Next day you leave short note (쪽지) on neighbour door. Apologize, talk wetin you go do, and thank dem. Use polite speech.
k-05.s.s2.hint.0: Start with your apartment number, then apologize.
k-05.s.s2.hint.1: Mention time (like 9시 이후) or behavior wey you go change.
k-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: I go feel okay if neighbour write this to me?
k-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: I thank dem for telling me?

k-10.thinking.1: Change your judgement when new information come
k-10.title: How strong this request be?
k-10.goal: Change how you understand soft workplace request as more messages show, then reply to confirm wetin you go do and when.
k-10.material: Your 팀장 (team leader, your supervisor) dey send messages for company chat. Read dem one by one.
k-10.thinking.0: Judge how strong soft request be
k-10.prereq.0: E know -아/어 주세요 and -(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요
k-10.s.s1.prompt: Read each message, choose how to understand am, then continue.
k-10.s.s1.hint.0: Decide using only messages wey you don see so far.
k-10.s.s1.hint.1: Ask who dey talk to who and wetin supervisor usually expect.
k-10.s.s1.st.0.after: From supervisor, '혹시 ... 주실 수 있을까요?' na normally polite way to ask make person do something. At first, fit read am literally as question about your free time, but next messages show say na real request.
k-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Soft but real request from supervisor; dem expect you to do am
k-10.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Favor wey no compulsory; you fit ignore am
k-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Supervisor request hardly be optional; soft words (혹시, 시간 되면) only make am polite.
k-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Question about whether you get free time
k-10.s.s1.st.0.r.d: No word like 지금 or 당장 dey, so e no be immediate order.
k-10.s.s1.st.1.after: '-까지만 보면 돼요' set limit: before tomorrow meeting. '급한 건 아니고요' only mean say no emergency.
k-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: '내일 오전 회의 전까지만' set closer limit than 'this week'.
k-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: '급한 건 아니고요' say e no urgent, so e no mean right now.
k-10.s.s1.st.1.r.d: '전까지' mean before meeting, no be after.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.after: '더 좋고요' na wish, no be rule, but supervisor wish matter. Plan to check am today or politely ask how important di wish be.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Do nothing till morning; deadline na di meeting
k-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: This meet stated deadline but ignore new wish for today ('더 좋고요'); supervisor wish usually count.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Try check am before you leave today, and finish before meeting
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ignore new message; first deadline na di real one
k-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: New message add to first one; e no cancel am, and supervisor wish matter.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Reply ask whether checking today necessary or just welcome
k-10.s.s1.reflect: Soft request from supervisor usually still mean say dem expect you to do am. Later messages usually add real deadline; softest sentence no mean 'optional'.
k-10.s.s2.prompt: Reply 팀장님 for chat with polite speech. Confirm say you go do am and talk when.
k-10.s.s2.hint.0: Start by showing say you accept.
k-10.s.s2.hint.1: Name two times: 오늘 and di meeting.
k-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: I clearly talk wetin I go do and by when?
k-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Team leader go satisfy with this reply?

k-06.title: My friend fit get refund?
k-06.goal: Put notice, table and friend message together to decide refund amount, point to needed evidence, and explain am to friend for Korean.
k-06.s.s1.prompt: How much refund your friend fit get?
k-06.s.s1.hint.0: Work out one third and one half of 8 lessons.
k-06.s.s1.hint.1: Compare your friend 3 lessons with those two numbers.
k-06.s.s1.r.a: Full refund only apply before course start. Your friend don attend 3 lessons.
k-06.s.s1.r.b: Two-thirds only apply before one third of lessons don pass. 3 of 8 more than one-third (around 2.7).
k-06.s.s1.r.d: No refund only apply after half (4 of 8) don pass. Your friend only do 3.
k-06.s.s1.explain: 3 of 8 lessons pass one third (8 ÷ 3 ≈ 2.7) but less than half (4). So row ‘before half don pass’ apply: half refund.
k-06.s.s2.prompt: Which information you need to get that answer?
k-06.s.s2.hint.0: Which numbers you compare with the table?
k-06.s.s2.hint.1: Cross out anything wey no change the amount.
k-06.s.s2.o.c: You must apply on day wey no class dey.
k-06.s.s2.r.c: That only talk how to apply, no be how much dem go refund.
k-06.s.s2.r.d: The reason no change refund rule.
k-06.s.s2.explain: Table give fractions of whole course, so you need total number (8) and number of lessons already done (3). How to apply and why no matter for amount.
k-06.s.s2.acc.0: Know how to apply useful for next step, but e no change refund amount.
k-06.s.s3.prompt: Reply your friend for Korean: talk refund amount, give reason from numbers, and tell am wetin to do next. Casual or polite speech both okay.
k-06.s.s3.hint.0: Give answer first, then reason with numbers.
k-06.s.s3.hint.1: End with one instruction using 신청.
k-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: I talk why na half, no be full or nothing?

k-07.title: Same request, two listeners
k-07.goal: Decide which request to professor na command instead of softened request, then write same request to professor and close friend.
k-07.material: You sick and miss Tuesday class. You need the lecture slides. You go ask professor by message, and ask classmate wey be your close friend and same age too.
k-07.thinking.0: Judge how strong the request be
k-07.thinking.2: Rewrite same meaning for different listener
k-07.s.s1.prompt: Which message no suitable to send professor?
k-07.s.s1.hint.0: All four formal for tone, so check another thing: each message dey ask or dey tell?
k-07.s.s1.hint.1: Imagine professor dey read each message: which one sound like instruction?
k-07.s.s1.r.a: This one fit: ‘-(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요?’ na softened question wey give professor room to say no.
k-07.s.s1.r.c: This one fit: e ask if possible instead of telling professor to do something.
k-07.s.s1.r.d: This one fit: ‘-(으)시면 감사하겠습니다’ na common formal way to make request.
k-07.s.s1.explain: b tell professor wetin to do (‘보내세요’) and add deadline (‘오늘 안에 꼭’); na order. The others ask, so professor free to answer.
k-07.s.s2.prompt: Write your own message to professor to ask for slides. Talk why you miss class.
k-07.s.s2.hint.0: Start with person wey you dey write to.
k-07.s.s2.hint.1: Use question form like ‘-(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요?’ to soften am.
k-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: The request soft, no be command?

k-08.title: Invitation wey no be invitation
k-08.goal: Find the line where greeting turn into real invitation, explain neighbour reaction, and fix the reply.
k-08.material:
You meet neighbour for elevator. Sometimes una greet each other, but una no close.

The conversation:
k-08.s.s1.prompt: Conversation turn awkward. Pick line wey cause am: phrase wey fit mean two things, reply wey turn am to plan, or follow-up wey push plan again.
k-08.s.s1.hint.0: Find first line where one person become more specific than the other.
k-08.s.s1.hint.1: Ask: neighbour own sentence mention any time or place?
k-08.s.s1.explain: ‘언제 밥 한번 먹어요’ (line 3) often na friendly way to end chat, like ‘make we eat sometime’. Line 4 treat am as real plan and choose date. Neighbour hesitation (…, 글쎄요, 나중에) show pressure. Line 6 (‘그럼 다음 주는요? 몇 시가 좋아요?’) push plan again after neighbour hesitate.
k-08.s.s2.hint.0: Neighbour sentence mention any time or place?
k-08.s.s2.hint.1: Think about how people end short chat for elevator.
k-08.s.s2.o.a: ‘Make we eat sometime’ na friendly phrase, and fixed date fit feel like pressure.
k-08.s.s2.o.b: Neighbour no like you and want you go away.
k-08.s.s2.r.b: Nothing for conversation say that. Neighbour remain polite the whole time.
k-08.s.s2.r.c: E possible, but neighbour wey really wan meet go suggest another day; hesitant, non-committal tone fit pleasantry better.
k-08.s.s2.r.d: The answers concern the plan, no be understanding.
k-08.s.s2.explain: Same words fit be real invitation or pleasantry. Tone and context (no close, inside elevator, no time mention) show pleasantry here.
k-08.s.s2.acc.0: Neighbour fit truly dey busy, but hesitant tone explain am better as pleasantry.
k-08.s.s3.prompt: Write better reply to ‘네. 언제 밥 한번 먹어요.’ wey friendly but no set date.
k-08.s.s3.hint.0: Agree generally without naming day or time.
k-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: My reply leave neighbour free to say yes later?

k-09.title: E fit happen tonight?
k-09.goal: Read building notice wey get list like table, decide which missing fact really change answer, check draft reply, and write complete reply to new neighbour.
k-09.thinking.0: Decide which missing information change the answer
k-09.s.s1.prompt: To give ONE exact answer to ‘Can I put these out tonight?’, which question you need ask neighbour first?
k-09.s.s1.hint.0: Check each item (박스, 소파, 페트병) and ask: answer for tonight already clear?
k-09.s.s1.hint.1: For which item answer depend on detail wey neighbour no give?
k-09.s.s1.r.b: Whatever answer, sofa no fit go outside tonight (collection na Thursday). You fit advise reporting without asking.
k-09.s.s1.r.c: Color no matter for the rules.
k-09.s.s1.r.d: Bottle fit go outside tonight anyway; you fit just tell neighbour to empty and rinse dem.
k-09.s.s1.r.e: Move-in time no relate to the rules.
k-09.s.s1.explain: Paper dey go out Tuesday (tonight okay), but Styrofoam na Wednesday (no be tonight). ‘박스’ alone no tell which one e be. You fit answer both cases at once too, but na only this fact change answer; sofa na ‘no’ either way.
k-09.s.s2.prompt: Dem write draft reply from notice. Choose the wrong line.
k-09.s.s2.hint.0: Check every line against matching row of table.
k-09.s.s2.hint.1: Look at row for 대형 폐기물: when and how?
k-09.s.s2.explain: Large waste (소파) must report first and put out on collection day, Thursday before 7 a.m., with sticker attached. E no fit go out tonight.
k-09.s.s3.prompt: Write reply to your new neighbour (polite speech) wey cover all three items.
k-09.s.s3.hint.0: Take each item one by one: 페트병, 박스, 소파.
k-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: I give condition for di box instead of guessing?
k-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: My tone friendly to new neighbor?
k-09.s.s3.selfAssess.3: I mention say dem must report di sofa to office first and put sticker?
k-09.s.s3.modelNote.1: Shorter; e no mention di Styrofoam case.

k-11.title: Declining two invitations
k-11.goal: Choose refusals wey okay for supervisor, then write one refusal to supervisor and another to colleague wey dey your level.
k-11.material:
You get another appointment today. Two invitations come.

팀장님: "오늘 저녁에 다 같이 회식하려고 하는데, 시간 되는 사람은 같이 가요."
입사 동기 (colleague wey start work same time as you, close friend): "오늘 퇴근하고 치킨 먹을래?"
k-11.thinking.0: Choose speech style for supervisor and colleague
k-11.thinking.1: Write soft refusal with reason and another option
k-11.thinking.2: Rewrite same refusal for another person
k-11.s.s1.prompt: Which refusals fit to send to 팀장님? Choose all wey fit di situation.
k-11.s.s1.hint.0: For each message, note if e apologize or show regret, give reason, and soften with something like '-ㄹ 것 같습니다'.
k-11.s.s1.hint.1: Choose every message wey do at least two of dem in way supervisor go accept.
k-11.s.s1.r.a: Suitable (apology, reason, softener). E no be only suitable one, so check other choices too.
k-11.s.s1.r.b: Ending formal, but message na plain statement: no apology, no regret and no softening ('안 갑니다' na flat 'I no dey go'), wey too blunt for supervisor.
k-11.s.s1.r.c: Suitable (regret, reason, formal). E no be only suitable one, so check other choices too.
k-11.s.s1.r.d: Suitable (reason, softener, promise about next time). E no be only suitable one, so check other choices too.
k-11.s.s1.explain: a and c apologize or show regret ('죄송하지만', '아쉽지만'), give reason and soften refusal. d give reason, soften with '못 갈 것 같습니다' and promise next time. b only talk flat refusal ('안 갑니다'), so e sound blunt even though ending formal.
k-11.s.s1.acc.0: Both fit; d add promise for next time too, so choosing all three na fullest answer.
k-11.s.s2.prompt: Write your refusal to 팀장님. Use polite/formal speech, soften am, give reason and mention next time.
k-11.s.s2.hint.0: Start with apology or thanks, then reason.
k-11.s.s2.hint.1: End with promise about next time.
k-11.s.s2.selfAssess.0: 팀장님 go feel respected and no feel say you reject dem?
k-11.s.s2.modelNote.1: Thanks first; 해요체 with respectful opening.
k-11.s.s3.prompt: Now refuse your 동기 chicken invitation with casual speech. Keep am friendly and suggest another time.
k-11.s.s3.hint.0: Make di sentence shorter and remove formal ending.
k-11.s.s3.hint.1: Say sorry, give reason and talk 'next time'.
